blocks.html:
Cool Splatter Effect Wrap by Vinyl Wrap Toronto

This customer wanted to celebrate the NBA Raptors Championship win by doing a special celebratory wrap. No one else can claim they have a Splatter Effect Wrap to honour the Raptors Championship win.
The vinyl was designed, printed, and installed in-house by our graphic designer and vinyl installer. Our installation crew has 20 years of combined experience applying 3M and Avery Dennison vinyl wrapping products.
The truck was wrapped using 3M Wrap Film Series 1080 to create the Splatter Effect wrap.

Do you need a car wrap, van wrap, truck wrap, or even a plane wrap? We at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, do it all! From vehicle graphics to equipment graphics, we can wrap everything that you can imagine. We are here to offer guaranteed satisfaction from design to implementation of the wrap!
